that bin becomes a red-black tree, capping the worst case at O(log n), a defense against hash-collision attacksHashMap = 배열 + 칸마다 리스트(또는 트리)a HashMap is an array with a list, or tree, per bin평균 O(1), 느리면 되므로, 느릴 확률은 1 − 0.99^N이에요 · 계산값 9.6%, 39.5%, 63.4%와 거의 같았어요with N = 1, 0.9% of requests exceeded 40 ms, rising to 9.9% at 10, 43.3% at 50 and 68.0% at 100, because one slow call among N is enough to slow the whole request, giving a probability of 1 − 0.99^N, close to the computed 9.6%, 39.5% and 63.4%N이 100이면 중간값부터 51.9ms였어요 · 개별 백엔드의 p99가 사용자 요청의 p50이 된 거예요 · N이 커지면 동시에 쏟아지는 요청 때문에 백엔드 자체도 조금 느려져서 계산값보다 약간 나빴어요at N = 100 the median itself was 51.9 ms, the individual backend’s p99 having become the user request’s p50, and with large N the burst of concurrent calls slowed the backend a little too, making results slightly worse than computed그래서 팬아웃이 큰 시스템은 평균이 아니라 개별 서버의 p99, p999를 관리해요 · 다음 항목의 헤지 요청, 늦은 응답은 빼고 답하기, 팬아웃 수 줄이기가 대표적인 대책이에요systems with large fan-out therefore manage the individual server’s p99 and p999 rather than averages, with hedged requests from the next item, answering without late responses and reducing fan-out as the typical remediesN개를 모두 기다려요waiting for all N1 − 0.99^N1 − 0.99^Np99가 p50이 돼요p99 becomes p50팬아웃 요청Fan-out requests느린 요청의 비율The share of slow requests중간값까지 느려져요Even the median slows꼬리 관리Managing the tail팬아웃과 꼬리 지연Fan-out and tail latency
